description: The plot illustrates the loss values of different models over a range of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000 with tick labels at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and also has a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays six lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue, solid). All lines start at a high loss value around 3.4 at 0 iterations and decrease rapidly to a minimum loss value between 20,000 to 40,000 iterations. The Vanilla model reaches a loss value of approximately 2.7 at 40,000 iterations and remains relatively stable thereafter. The StrmLLM (n=64) model has a loss value around 2.9 at 40,000 iterations and remains steady. The SepLLM models with different configurations have loss values ranging from approximately 2.75 to 2.85 at 40,000 iterations and remain relatively stable, with SepLLM (n=128) having the lowest loss value among the SepLLM models. All lines exhibit a similar trend of a sharp decline followed by a relatively stable loss value, with some minor fluctuations.
